streaming_input.text: According to Alderwick's fictional heritage booklet, the festival celebrates communal light during
the lengthening nights, remembers fishers once guided home by lanterns, and
expresses hope and mutual care before winter. The procession was formalized in 1
Wear ordinary neat, weather-appropriate clothing; traditional dress is not expected.
If entering the chapel courtyard for the remembrance ceremony, cover your shoulders and wear
clothing reaching roughly to the knee. Otherwise, you may remain on the public qu
ay. Closed-toe shoes and a warm waterproof layer are advisable.
